ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Fashion Illustration. In the Fashion Illustration studio class the students will learn the fundamental techniques specific to fashion design used in the apparel industry, discovering the different types of Fashion Drawings and where they are used. Students will learn how to create fashion croquis from standard fashion proportion, how to draw and render fabrics and textures using traditional techniques and the more common software used in Fashion companies. Through the exploration of different media and proportions the students will learn how to communicate fashion concept using their personal expression.
